public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        
        long[] c = new long[2 * n + 2];
        c[n] = 1;
        
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            long val = (2 * c[i + 1]) % m;
            for (int j = 2; i * j <= 2 * n && j <= n / i + 1; j++) {
                // The Python code uses c[i*j] and c[(i+1)*j]
                // We must ensure indices are within bounds of the array
                long term1 = (i * j < c.length) ? c[i * j] : 0;
                long term2 = ((i + 1) * j < c.length) ? c[(i + 1) * j] : 0;
                val = (val + term1 - term2) % m;
            }
            c[i] = (val + m) % m;
        }
        
        long result = (c[1] - c[2]) % m;
        System.out.println((result + m) % m);
    }
}
